name: Rest Camp
description: The long exhale between fights, now with a replay-safe transaction boundary. Rest Camp owns rest eligibility, one active rest, its timer identity and generation, the persisted ambush roll, and completed-versus-interrupted outcome. It does not own health, named resources, prepared casts, inventory, or the ambush spawn. Authored profiles declare duration, safe-zone and combat policy, ambush chance, and a recovery plan. A stable restId dedupes accepted and rejected requests. Starting emits world.restStarted and no recovery; timer completion either emits world.restCompleted with the plan or world.restInterrupted plus world.restAmbushRequested. Explicit interruption, a hit against a resting member, or member defeat interrupts without recovery. A stale timer after interruption cannot complete the rest. Unit Roster, Resource Pools, and Prepared Spellbook consume only world.restCompleted and dedupe that restId independently. Dynamic Encounter Spawner may convert an ambush request into ordinary spawns. Legacy input.restRequested without a profile uses the original duration, safe-zone, ambush, and per-rest settings; id-less legacy calls retain legacy behavior rather than inventing a durable identity. Restoring active state, rolls, generations, and processedRestIds emits no historical rest or recovery events.

inputs.name: restDurationSeconds
inputs.description: Real time the rest takes. Long enough to feel like a commitment, short enough to not be a loading screen with a campfire.

inputs.name: baseAmbushChance
inputs.description: Ambush probability before modifiers. 0.15 is often enough to make posting a watch a habit, rare enough that resting stays worth it.

inputs.name: requiresSafeZone
inputs.description: Whether rest is restricted to designated campsites. True is the hardcore mode; false lets the ambush chance carry the entire risk budget.

inputs.name: restoresPerRestAbilities
inputs.description: Whether per-rest ability charges come back. The whole point of the component; exposed so a survival variant can say no.

inputs.name: profiles
inputs.description: Authored rest profiles: {id, durationSeconds, requiresSafeZone, allowInCombat, ambushChance, recovery}. Recovery entries are {resourceId, mode flat|percentMax|full, amount?}; completion expands them across the requested memberIds, while health, named-resource, and prepared-cast owners apply their own parts.

inputs.name: initialState
inputs.description: Restored activeRest, persisted ambushRoll, timer generation, processedRestIds, last outcome, and last rejection.

outputs.name: lastRestOutcome
outputs.description: completed | interrupted — for camp UI and analytics.

outputs.name: ambushChance
outputs.description: The computed probability for the pending rest, shown to the player before committing.

outputs.name: activeRest
outputs.description: Pending restId, profileId, memberIds, remainingSeconds, timerId, generation, and persisted ambushRoll; null when no rest is active.

outputs.name: processedRestIds
outputs.description: Durable accepted and rejected rest-request dedupe ledger.

outputs.name: lastRejected
outputs.description: Latest rejected rest request with restId and reason unknownProfile|unsafe|inCombat|alreadyResting|invalidRequest.
